limits: Uses original ideal-clock SDC edge times and max-input-delay; no cell delay, library setup/recovery or post-ECO PT timing has been substituted.
The witness is conditional on analyzing this HF-launch/LF-capture edge pair. Native PT expansion must confirm the analyzed pair and return actual library checks.
At the witness edge, any nonnegative combinational delay worsens the zero-cell-delay bound; this does not prove a particular native slack or qualify the design.
Increasing clock expansion cannot be assumed to improve coverage without exposing new failures. No false paths, IO changes, frequency changes or clock grouping are proposed.
